summary.oneLiner: 10x Vibe Marketing helps professionals master AI automation skills specifically for marketing applications
summary.targetAudience: Professionals who want to leverage AI for marketing but feel overwhelmed by generic AI courses
summary.primaryGoal: Get visitors to schedule a demo/discovery call
summary.keyDifferentiator: Exclusively focused on marketing applications of AI - no generic AI fluff

audienceProfile.primarySegment: Marketing professionals, business owners, and career-changers looking to future-proof their skills
painPoints: Overwhelmed by the pace of AI change in marketing
Frustrated with generic AI courses that don't apply to their work
Worried about being left behind as AI transforms marketing
Wasting time on tools that don't deliver results
audienceProfile.desiredOutcome: Confidently use AI to automate marketing tasks, saving time and getting better results
audienceProfile.currentSituation: Aware that AI is transforming marketing but unsure how to practically apply it
emotionalDrivers: Desire to work smarter, not harder
Pride in staying ahead of the curve

objectionStrategy.bestCounter: ROI focus - the skills pay for themselves through time saved and better results. Plus, compare cost to falling behind competitors.
objectionStrategy.proofNeeded: Show the value of time saved, potential earnings increase, or cost of NOT learning these skills

objectionStrategy.bestCounter: Step-by-step approach designed for marketers, not developers. No coding required. Learn at your own pace.
objectionStrategy.proofNeeded: Show ease of learning, beginner-friendly language, certifications as proof of structured learning

objectionStrategy.bestCounter: Learn in short modules. The time invested now saves 10x more time through automation. Even busy professionals find 30 min/day.
objectionStrategy.proofNeeded: Highlight flexible learning, quick wins, and time ROI

secondaryCTA.forWho: Not ready to commit but interested

conversionPath.step1: Visitor reads headline and recognizes their situation
conversionPath.step2: Scrolls through benefits and sees objections addressed
conversionPath.step3: Clicks CTA to schedule a free strategy call

positioning.uniqueValue: The only AI skills training built exclusively for marketing professionals
positioning.whyDifferent: While others teach AI broadly, we focus 100% on marketing applications. Every lesson, every exercise, every skill is designed for marketers.
positioning.proofOfDifference: Curriculum designed around marketing workflows, certifications recognized in marketing industry

socialProofStrategy.testimonialFocus: Focus on certification value and practical skill application

sections.purpose: Capture attention with marketing-specific AI skills promise
Connect with frustration of generic AI training
Introduce marketing-focused AI training as the answer
Show outcomes and address 'too expensive' objection through value
Show simplicity and address 'too complicated' objection
Detail what they get and address 'no time' objection

pageStructure.scrollDepthGoal: Get to CTA within 3-4 scroll depths, full page for detail seekers

copywritingGuidance.headlineApproach: Focus on marketing-specific AI skills that save time and get results. Avoid generic 'learn AI' messaging.
copywritingGuidance.toneNotes: Confident expert sharing practical knowledge. Not salesy or hype-driven. Modern and fresh but substantive.

designGuidance.visualMood: Modern tech meets approachable education - innovative but welcoming
designGuidance.colorDirection: Fresh, modern palette. Consider blues/teals for trust + vibrant accent for innovation. Avoid corporate gray.
designGuidance.imageryStyle: Product screenshots, professional photos of learning, abstract tech elements. Show real UI if available.
designGuidance.layoutPriority: Clean and scannable. Strong visual hierarchy. CTA buttons prominent. Mobile-first thinking.
